Not only did she perform the service beautifully, but she also patiently educated me on how to maintain my hair health at home. She recommended products tailored specifically to my scalp type and shared small but meaningful daily tips that truly made a difference. Thanks to her, I’ve fallen in love with my hair again — something I didn’t think would happen after losing hope in how my hair looked. She's genuinely my Hair Fairy Godmother and truly an Angel..! ✨
I also want to appreciate Ashish, who assisted Zaara throughout the process. He handled my sensitive scalp so gently and professionally, making the entire experience very comfortable for me.
Additionally, I had my eyebrows done by Siddika, and I was blown away by her skill. For the first time ever, I experienced almost no pain while getting my eyebrows shaped. She understood exactly what I wanted and gave me the perfect shape — something I’ve been searching for after many disappointing experiences elsewhere. She’s incredibly talented, and I’m so relieved to finally find someone I can trust with my brows.
Overall, this visit was truly rejuvenating and transformative. I left the salon not just looking better, but feeling more confident and cared for. I will definitely be recommending Looks Salon to my friends and family — especially the wonderful team members who made my experience outstanding: Pradosh, Zaara Kazi, Ashish, and Siddika.

There’s only one reason for the bad rating - misinformation and overcharging.

Today (27 Dec) I went for a haircut and beard trim. It was my repeat visit (2nd) because I had liked the haircut during my visit before. Even today the haircut and beard trim is perfect, exactly what I wanted.

The issue is this: while cutting my hair, the gentleman asked me to take a hair spa, which I declined because my in laws were waiting over lunch for me. Then he said I could go for a combo - haircut + beard trim + head massage - for just 550 bucks. I asked how long the massage would take and he said it wouldn’t take long. I said okay.

After applying oil on my head he said he had forgotten that the combo was only for the weekdays and not for the weekends. That seemed like planned (I’m pretty sure it was). I enquired what would the charges be in that case. He said he’d give me a discount.

I was charged 750 bucks in the end. I felt cheated. I didn’t say anything. I don’t even know if I got any discount at all. But it didn’t matter. If you commit something, you should stick to it. The customer shouldn’t pay for your mistake. That seemed like a planned misinformation.

Such a shame that I was offered a great haircut and trim, but a bad experience. Not going to visit again.
